method.output: Same production-equivalent sRGB gamut mapping and 16-bit encoding
method.adaptation: Bradford, D50 to D65 for ProPhoto; no chromatic adaptation for Rec2020/D65
method.Y_reference: Common XYZ D65 Y, weights transformed to each workspace
method.operators: Exposure gains .5/2; chroma gain 1.25 around common Y; signed RGB power 1.2 is basis-dependent diagnostic, not production slider; cube clamp explicitly isolated
method.timings: Three NumPy transform/operator/inverse passes; excludes decode, output, metrics and I/O; NOT application latency benchmark
method.previews: 16-bit sRGB PNG on sample grid, cv2 outputs without embedded ICC; no source edits

units.errors: absolute linear RGB, native 16-bit codes, or Delta E00 as named
units.memory: logical buffer bytes, not measured peak RSS

limitations: Seven supplied scenes only; no camera-independent validation
Post-DCP signal: cannot recover upstream clipping
No aligned pixel comparison to Lightroom; LR distributions are neutral references only
Synthetic diagnostic operators do not migrate or validate all production adjustments
Native sample grids are not full-resolution detail validation
No perceptual ranking from out-of-cube counts alone
